description: Find campgrounds in the US by name, area or state, across Recreation.gov and state park booking systems. Use this when someone wants a place to camp or asks about a specific campground. Returns up to 10 campgrounds with their PermitSnag page, their booking system, and whether PermitSnag can send an alert when a site opens. It does not check dates; use check_availability for that.

query.description: A campground name or area, like "Upper Pines" or "Big Sur".

state.description: Optional two-letter US state code to narrow results, like CA.

name: search_campgrounds

outputSchema.description: US campgrounds that match the search.

depth.description: site_level: our checks count individual sites. campground_level: the booking system reports the campground as a whole.

scannable.description: True when PermitSnag checks this campground for openings. Whether an alert is on offer today is in get_campground_details.

title: Search US campgrounds
